description: This file implements HTTP header manipulation interfaces for a web server, including functions for extracting, setting, appending, and removing HTTP headers in request and response contexts. It also contains internal utilities for parsing and handling header strings.

methods.name: enum:http_header_e http_header_hkey_get(const char * const s,const size_t slen)
